name: Anvil Sparks
body:
School conjuration (creation) [fire, sonic]; Level cleric/oracle 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target suddenly hears the ring of a hammer hitting an anvil, and hot sparks, like those from a forge, fly around them. The sparks deal 1d3 points of fire damage to the target and 1 point to any creatures within 5 feet of the target.
